# HobbyOS libc++/libc++abi source list for the bare-metal static build.
#
# One line per translation unit, relative to the extracted tree:
#   L  = <vendor>/src/llvm-project-<ver>.src/libcxx
#   A  = <vendor>/src/llvm-project-<ver>.src/libcxxabi
#
# Derived from libcxx/src/CMakeLists.txt + libcxxabi/src/CMakeLists.txt at
# llvmorg-21.1.8 with this option set (see README.md "Build configuration"):
#
#   LIBCXX_ENABLE_THREADS=ON          (P1 pthreads backend)
#   LIBCXX_ENABLE_LOCALIZATION=ON     (C-only; <sstream>/<iostream> need it)
#   LIBCXX_ENABLE_RANDOM_DEVICE=ON    (libc getentropy() -> SYS_GETRANDOM)
#   LIBCXX_ENABLE_FILESYSTEM=OFF      (no <filesystem>: FAT16-only VFS)
#   LIBCXX_ENABLE_NEW_DELETE_DEFINITIONS=ON   (libcxx/src/new.cpp)
#   LIBCXX_ENABLE_EXCEPTIONS=OFF / LIBCXX_ENABLE_RTTI=OFF  (browser.md §6 P3.1)
#   LIBCXX_INCLUDE_WIN32/ZOS/sanitizers=OFF
#   LIBCXXABI_ENABLE_EXCEPTIONS=OFF   (cxa_noexception.cpp, not cxa_exception.cpp
#                                      /cxa_personality.cpp)
#   LIBCXXABI_ENABLE_THREADS=ON       (cxa_thread_atexit.cpp)
#   LIBCXXABI_ENABLE_NEW_DELETE_DEFINITIONS=OFF — stdlib_new_delete.cpp is
#     deliberately NOT built: libcxx/src/new.cpp provides the same weak
#     operator new/delete in this combined archive (one definition set).
#
# libcxxabi C++ABI files:
A src/cxa_aux_runtime.cpp
A src/cxa_default_handlers.cpp
A src/cxa_demangle.cpp
A src/cxa_exception_storage.cpp
A src/cxa_guard.cpp
A src/cxa_handlers.cpp
A src/cxa_vector.cpp
A src/cxa_virtual.cpp
# libcxxabi no-exceptions support (LIBCXXABI_ENABLE_EXCEPTIONS=OFF):
A src/cxa_noexception.cpp
# libcxxabi thread support (TLS destructors):
A src/cxa_thread_atexit.cpp
# libcxxabi STL files:
A src/stdlib_exception.cpp
A src/stdlib_stdexcept.cpp
A src/stdlib_typeinfo.cpp
# libcxxabi internal:
A src/abort_message.cpp
A src/fallback_malloc.cpp
# A src/private_typeinfo.cpp -- EXCLUDED: implements __dynamic_cast and the
# __*_type_info cast machinery, which requires -frtti to compile.  The
# milestone policy is "no exceptions, no RTTI" (browser.md section 6 P3.1),
# so the cast machinery is out of scope; user code doing dynamic_cast /<typeid>
# gets a link-time gap by design.  Revisit if a later milestone needs it
# (would need -frtti for this TU only, or RTTI=ON for the archive).
# libcxx always-on:
L src/algorithm.cpp
L src/any.cpp
L src/bind.cpp
L src/call_once.cpp
# L src/charconv.cpp -- EXCLUDED (see README.md "Build configuration"):
# its floating-point from_chars impl pulls llvm-libc headers
# (libc/shared/fp_bits.h -> libc/src/__support/FPUtil/FPBits.h) that
# are outside the vendored subtrees.  Integral to_chars/from_chars are
# header-only and unaffected; float charconv is a documented gap.
L src/chrono.cpp
L src/error_category.cpp
L src/exception.cpp
L src/expected.cpp
L src/functional.cpp
L src/hash.cpp
L src/memory.cpp
L src/memory_resource.cpp
L src/new_handler.cpp
L src/new_helpers.cpp
L src/optional.cpp
L src/print.cpp
L src/random_shuffle.cpp
L src/ryu/d2fixed.cpp
L src/ryu/d2s.cpp
L src/ryu/f2s.cpp
L src/stdexcept.cpp
L src/string.cpp
L src/system_error.cpp
L src/typeinfo.cpp
L src/valarray.cpp
L src/variant.cpp
L src/vector.cpp
L src/verbose_abort.cpp
# libcxx threads (LIBCXX_ENABLE_THREADS=ON):
L src/atomic.cpp
L src/barrier.cpp
L src/condition_variable_destructor.cpp
L src/condition_variable.cpp
L src/future.cpp
L src/mutex_destructor.cpp
L src/mutex.cpp
L src/shared_mutex.cpp
L src/thread.cpp
# libcxx random device (LIBCXX_ENABLE_RANDOM_DEVICE=ON):
L src/random.cpp
# libcxx localization (LIBCXX_ENABLE_LOCALIZATION=ON):
L src/fstream.cpp
L src/ios.cpp
L src/ios.instantiations.cpp
L src/iostream.cpp
L src/locale.cpp
L src/ostream.cpp
L src/regex.cpp
L src/strstream.cpp
# libcxx new/delete definitions (LIBCXX_ENABLE_NEW_DELETE_DEFINITIONS=ON):
L src/new.cpp

# -- compiler-rt builtins (llvmorg-21.1.8, compiler-rt/lib/builtins) --------
# IEEE binary128 (long double on aarch64) helpers that clang emits for
# long-double arithmetic, comparisons and conversions.  libc++'s own objects
# instantiate algorithm templates over long double, so the archive must
# carry them.  Built for both arches; on x86_64 long double is x87 and the
# set is simply unreferenced.
R addtf3.c
R subtf3.c
R multf3.c
R divtf3.c
R comparetf2.c
R extenddftf2.c
R extendsftf2.c
R trunctfdf2.c
R trunctfsf2.c
R floatsitf.c
R floatunsitf.c
R floatditf.c
R floatunditf.c
R fixtfsi.c
R fixtfdi.c
R fixunstfsi.c
R fixunstfdi.c
R int_util.c
